style: hand-painted 2D animation, styled like a 1911 autochrome photograph, muted colors, warm gold chandelier light against cold green baize, soft film grain, gentle vignette, Berlin 1911

shots.image: Close-up of a yellowed 1911 Berlin newspaper page lying on a marble café table next to a cup of coffee, dense columns of German Fraktur type, one short news column circled in pencil, a hand in a sand-colored sleeve resting beside it, warm lamp light
shots.motion: slow push-in on the circled column, the finger slides along the lines of text

shots.image: Snowy night street in Berlin 1911, Kurfürstendamm, horse-drawn carriages, glowing sign 'Fortuna' above a grand casino entrance, gas lamps
shots.motion: slow push-in toward the entrance, snow falling, a carriage passes

shots.image: Opulent casino hall 1911, mirrors, crystal chandeliers, dark spiral columns, gilded paintings, ladies in long dark gowns, gentlemen in tailcoats with monocles, stewards in red embroidered jackets carrying trays
shots.motion: smooth dolly over the crowd, stewards moving between tables

shots.image: Clean-shaven man about 35 in a sand-colored military-style tunic, looking around a casino hall, a servant nods toward a tall thin man in a long dark-blue naval-style frock coat
shots.motion: the man in the tunic looks surprised, then steps back into the crowd

shots.image: Roulette table in a 1911 casino, tall thin man in dark-blue frock coat sitting, stacks of gold and silver coins, spectators standing in a tight semicircle, croupier in tailcoat
shots.motion: the thin man lays out coin stacks, croupier gestures to place bets

shots.image: Close-up of a hand placing a tall stack of gold coins on number 17 black on green baize; a second hand in a sand-colored sleeve pushes silver coins onto 18 red
shots.motion: quick hurried push of silver coins

shots.image: Macro shot of an ivory roulette ball bouncing across brass pockets of a spinning chrome roulette wheel
shots.motion: ball slows and settles in pocket 24 black, croupier's rake sweeps coins away

shots.image: Hand-drawn cartoon, extreme close-up of the young clean-shaven man in the sand-colored tunic from the reference, seen from a low side angle, pale shocked face, sweat on the forehead, chandelier bokeh behind, casino crowd blurred
shots.motion: he swallows, his eyes slowly drop down toward the table

shots.image: The tall thin man pushes all his remaining coins onto 17 black, tense crowd leaning in around the roulette table
shots.motion: wheel spins, ball lands on 18 red, crowd gasps

shots.image: Hand-drawn cartoon, wide high-angle view from a gallery over the casino hall: waiters with trays of champagne flutes, the tall thin man in the dark-blue frock coat from the reference raises a glass and bows to the cheering crowd, the young man in the sand-colored tunic stands alone at the edge, a young reporter in a flat cap writes in a notebook
shots.motion: the crowd surges toward the champagne, the thin man bows and walks away, the camera slowly pulls back
